question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT lt.id_bioguide, l.gender, lt.state, lt.term_start
    FROM legislators_terms lt
    JOIN legislators l ON lt.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
years_to_check AS (
    SELECT 0 AS year_offset UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 10
),
legislator_years AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.id_bioguide,
        ft.gender,
        ft.state,
        y.year_offset,
        DATE(ft.term_start) + (y.year_offset * INTERVAL '1 year') AS check_date
    FROM first_terms ft
    CROSS JOIN years_to_check y
),
retention AS (
    SELECT 
        ly.id_bioguide,
        ly.gender,
        ly.state,
        ly.year_offset,
        ly.check_date,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ly.id_bioguide
            AND DATE(lt.term_start) <= ly.check_date
            AND DATE(lt.term_end) > ly.check_date
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
    FROM legislator_years ly
),
state_gender_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        year_offset,
        MAX(retained) AS all_retained
    FROM retention
    GROUP BY state, gender, year_offset
),
state_gender_all_retained AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        COUNT(DISTINCT year_offset) AS retained_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT year_offset) AS total_offsets
    FROM state_gender_retention
    WHERE all_retained = 1
    GROUP BY state, gender
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year_offset) = 6
)
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM state_gender_all_retained
WHERE gender = 'M'
INTERSECT
SELECT DISTINCT state
FROM state_gender_all_retained
WHERE gender = 'F'
ORDER BY state
